label: TP
reason: The code is vulnerable to SQL injection because the user-provided parameter 'param' is directly concatenated into the SQL query string without any sanitization or parameterization. Although the code attempts to encode the SQL query for HTML display, this does not prevent the injection attack since the malicious input is already embedded in the query before execution.

evidence.note: User-provided parameter 'param' is directly concatenated into SQL query string without sanitization
getParameterValues(...) is the source of user-provided input
The SQL query construction concatenates user input directly into the query string, creating an XSS vulnerability as well
